caseName: United States v. Lehigh Valley Railroad
caseNameFull: United States v. Lehigh Valley Railroad Co.
attorneys: Simon E. Sobeloff, then Solicitor General, Assistant Attorney General Burger, Melvin Richter and Morton Hollander for the United States.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The petition for writ of certiorari is granted. The judgment of the court below is reversed and the case is remanded to the Court of Claims for further proceedings not inconsistent with the opinion of this Court in United States v. Western Pacific R. Co., 352 U. S. 59.
